RecordingHardeningHarness absent/relative/in-job destination manifest requires new path; inside-job export is refused without losing tracks.

RecordingHardeningHarness redirects only NSURL scope boundaries: granted early failure balances1/1, granted actual asynchronous converter failure balances1/1 after -54 with raw tracks retained, refusal1/0, granted async success retains access through conversion then balances1/1 before callback.
Existing asynchronous WAV/MP3/Ogg and finalization-drain fixtures pass; SIP peer integrates real call-owner manifest admission and cleanup.

Scripts/run-sip-lifecycle-regression-tests.py: retired recording worker stop before endpoint destroy

items.notes: Create protected0700 Application Support recovery jobs with atomic0600 manifests and tracks. Persist before capture/export; publish failure to the app, reload jobs, offer retry/save elsewhere/reveal/later and an explicit quit choice. Retain raw audio until successful export. Require a new destination for missing/invalid/in-job manifests and reject destinations inside the raw job. Balance a granted security-scope token across async conversion and release it before any completion. Integrate peer durable raw directory and manifest APIs; retain failed exports and publish global recovery notification. Flush recorders synchronously on control worker before account deletion and endpoint teardown, then wait conversion queue before quit.
